notes:
CRM: Refused save: focus moves to the bad field (good), but the input has no aria-invalid, no aria-describedby linking the message, and there is no role=alert / aria-live region, so a screen reader does not announce the message or tie it to the field (checked in the DOM, crm-M4-refused.png)
DESK: Desk refused save: message under the field, but no aria-invalid, no aria-describedby, no role=alert/aria-live; focus goes to Subject (another required field), not the refused field (desk-M4-refused.png)
